android.desc: Just Run is a simple workout app to help you get running. I made this app to get myself off the couch and start running to get to 5K. Stick to the workout plan, and you'll be able to run 5K in 9 weeks. It really does work! If you're already able to run 5K, Just Run also has a 6-week plan to help you get up to 10K! Workout Plans - Zero to 5K: Gets you from absolute zero running experience to 5K in just 9 weeks, with three 30-minute workouts per week - 5K to 10K: If you can already run 5K, or have finished Zero to 5K, this plan gets you to 10K in only 6 weeks Features 📅 Target dates for each workout, calculated based on your progress, and optimal exercise days 📣 Choose from multiple trainer voices, which tell you exactly when to run and walk 📱 Lock screen notification so you don't need to unlock your phone to check your progress 🚫 No ads! Ads are no fun, so Just Run has no ads! 🎵 Works with music, audiobook and podcast apps - Just Run will briefly lower the volume of the other app when prompting you to run and walk, so you'll never miss a prompt 🔽 Tiny download (less than 5MB), so Just Run will take up very little space on your device ➕ Upgrade to Premium to get more trainer voices, multiple theme options, access to feature previews, and to support continued development of Just Run I'd love to hear how you're getting on with Just Run. You can email me at run@jupli.com. --- Just Run is the successor to Syncostyle's 5K Trainer and B210K Trainer. If you liked those, Just Run will feel very familiar!

quotes.text:
I normally don't shill anything but I think it's worth it since it's free and there are no ads.
Just Run.  It's a couch to 5k app that starts from a minute or so of running (really jogging) to running a full 30 minutes.  The amount of exertion at each step is manageable.  All you need after the first couple of weeks is an audio book to go with it and you're golden.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jupli.run&hl=en_US&gl=US

Disregard if you like, but it's the first app that had any sort of schedule that I've completed.  Good luck.
